basis: Initial engineering targets set during authorized P0 execution; these figures are not prior user-supplied promises or measured achievements. Changes must reopen P0.01 before evaluating a replacement target.

warm_completed_job.applies: Every selected recipe/method/explicit-device profile independently; no pooled averaging hides a failing profile.

cold_completed_job.includes: Fresh process, isolated empty application/compiler/JIT/autotune caches, initialization, full decode/alignment/fusion/export; OS disk caches are not claimed cold.

peak_memory.discrete_gpu: Enforce separately for process-tree peak resident memory and attributable peak GPU allocated/resident memory where reliably measurable. Do not move allocations from CPU to GPU to claim half memory.
peak_memory.apple_unified: Use peak task physical footprint as primary physical-memory metric; record peak RSS and logical GPU allocations separately, never add them to footprint. Same measurement tool/version and sampling rules for both targets.
peak_memory.unavailable_metric: Do not claim pass for an unmeasured required memory metric; mark profile pending.

viewer_event_to_present.event_set: source/result selection, pan, zoom and comparison drag on selected real 24MP image; exposure preview if exposed
viewer_event_to_present.endpoint: Native input dispatch timestamp to first presented correct image/state, not compute submission, callback return or screenshot call duration.
viewer_event_to_present.concurrent_load: Measure both idle and during real numerical processing.

pause_and_cancel.pause_endpoint: Worker has reached safe boundary, no new processing batch submits, truthful paused state is observed. UI receipt/Pausing alone is insufficient.
pause_and_cancel.cancel_endpoint: Worker has accepted cancellation and stopped new decode/compute submissions; truthful Cancelling state is observed. Track settled reusable Idle and resource-drain latency separately; never label unfinished cleanup Complete.
pause_and_cancel.measurement: Apply deadline to every sampled acknowledgement, not only mean; also report P50/P95/max and settled-state latency. Use actual 64-frame lifecycle workload and selected real jobs, never sleeps/barriers/business hooks.

reference.instrumentation: Disable Python/Rust coverage and profiling while measuring primary timings; retain actual backend evidence as separately recorded or identically instrumented validation run.

workloads.source_requirement: 50 distinct consecutive real optical focus frames; common recorded crop from native images at least 6000x4000 allowed; no synthetic source, resizing, repeated frame, or duplicated path to fill count.
50 distinct real optical focus frames from one capture, retaining full RAW decode and camera metadata; no embedded-thumbnail substitute.

workloads.dimensions: native, fixed and recorded across frames
workloads.input: native supported camera files or losslessly derived TIFF; record actual source precision
workloads.source_requirement: 150 distinct consecutive real deep-focus capture frames; retain source and conversion hashes.

workloads.dimensions: native, fixed and recorded across frames
workloads.input: original supported exposure-bracket files or provenance-pinned float32 linear TIFF derivatives
workloads.source_requirement: Nine distinct bracketed exposures of same scene/focus; not a focus stack and not nine repeats of one source.
workloads.exposure_batch_tree: 4+4+1 frames, equal final batch weights; preserve current contract semantics

warm.process_model: Each CLI job uses a fresh process but pre-warmed persistent compiler/shader/Numba caches and normal OS file caches. No decoded-input/result cache crosses jobs. Report GUI persistent-engine timings separately.
warm.timer: Monotonic parent wall clock immediately before process spawn through successful process exit with complete export closed/published. Decode output independently after timer to validate completion. Enqueue-only timings are invalid.
warm.primary_statistic: Median of 10 completed jobs; retain all samples, min, P50, nearest-rank P95 and max. Job P95 is descriptive at n=10, not tail certification.

cold.cache_policy: Unique case-owned application/compiler caches per run for both targets; do not delete global/user caches or install drivers during timed runs.
cold.primary_statistic: Median of 5 completed fresh-cache jobs; report each run and compile/setup breakdown separately where available.

latency.p95: Empirical nearest rank, sorted sample at ceil(0.95*n); no inferred FPS or image-pack kernel latency substitute.

measurement_protocol.scheduling: Serialize benchmark jobs per device. Alternate target order per pair. Same hardware, power mode, driver, OS, input bytes, method/settings and output depth. Record thermal/power state; no concurrent audit or GPU workloads. Rerun only for a documented invalid measurement, retaining original data and reason; never retry away numerical failure.
measurement_protocol.device_matching: Explicit CPU versus explicit CPU on same physical host; explicit GPU versus explicit GPU on same physical GPU. Native CUDA/HIP may compare against reference OpenCL on that physical GPU, with APIs disclosed. Never compare candidate CPU with baseline GPU, different devices, or only Auto selections; qualify Auto separately.
measurement_protocol.memory: Fresh process for every measured job; capture high-water marks over initialization through exit, including workers, staging, output encoding and cleanup. Record OS units and instrumentation. Sample device/process counters at <=20ms if no high-water counter; declare resolution and missed-short-peak limitation.
measurement_protocol.provenance: Freeze ordered selected input SHA256/byte-size/shape/exposure metadata, rights/source and conversion commands, target commit+lock+flags, physical device/driver/OS/power identity, timer/memory tool version, output hashes, samples and validation results.

read_only_corpus_discovery.scope: Existing workspace datasets/ plus versioned Bokehforge source configuration only; no personal photo-library scan.
read_only_corpus_discovery.observed: Workspace datasets/ contains .bokehforge state/cache/report directories; no TIFF/DNG/RAW files found by extension scan.
read_only_corpus_discovery.configured_candidate: D02: jjjsood/focus-stack-sample, raw CR3 macro capture, pinned config revision 0f8256edf2d2e3f1f1ea162f78a8bca36eb6915c, CC BY 4.0 per versioned source config; not selected/acquired/verified here.
read_only_corpus_discovery.budget: Preserve Bokehforge configured 2147483648-byte download cap; no implicit dataset acquisition authorized by this metadata.
